flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: Missing the cancellation window commits you to a further full 12-month term of dues at the then-current rate, which may be higher than what you pay now; notice that is even one day late pushes the effect to the end of the following term, with the intervening term's dues payable in full. A suspended, frozen or medically held membership still renews on schedule, so you could owe a full year while unable to use the club.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the fees you pay, the hours you can use, the classes available and any other term of the deal at any time, effective the moment it is posted at the club or on its website, and your continued use counts as your acceptance — so you could face higher charges or worse terms with no negotiated cap and no right to leave without penalty stated in the clause.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: You must pay and defend against third-party claims — including Meridian's reasonable legal fees — arising from your use of the facilities, your conduct, your guest's conduct, or any service you provide to another member, and Meridian chooses the lawyer and can block any settlement you might arrange. The obligation is not capped at a stated amount.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after your Program candidacy ends — for any reason, including Meridian ending it — you cannot teach, coach or deliver fitness or personal training, in any capacity, at any facility within 15 miles of any Meridian location where you taught or trained, and you cannot solicit Meridian members or candidates for outside instruction. This could block a large share of local fitness employment or self-employment for a year.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: You give up the right to a jury trial and to bring or join a class, collective or representative action against Meridian; any dispute — including a serious one about injury, billing or the Program — must go through a single-arbitrator process whose award is final, narrowing how you could contest a serious problem. You can opt out in writing within 30 days of first accepting, and opting out does not affect your membership or Program standing.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may adjust dues once in any twelve (12) month period by the greater of six percent (6%)  or the increase in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers over the preceding twelve months, on thirty (30) days notice to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Meridian can raise your dues once every 12 months by the greater of 6% or CPI on 30 days' email notice, so a year's costs could rise by at least 6% with no right to cancel stated in this clause.

flags.sourceSentence: Dues not received within ten (10) days of the draw date incur the late charge set out in the Schedule of Fees then in effect, which is posted at the Member Services desk and on the Meridian website and forms part of this Agreement.
flags.consequence: Late charges, the returned-payment charge, the keycard replacement charge and the account reinstatement charge are all set in a Schedule of Fees (Rev. 4) that is not in this document, so the amounts you would owe are not visible here and can be changed by posting under Section 4; non-payment within 10 days of the draw triggers the late charge.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian’s total liability to you for any claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or your use of any facility — whether the claim is framed in contract, in negligence or otherwise — will not exceed the total dues and fees you paid to Meridian in the twelve (12) months immediately before the event giving rise to the claim.
flags.consequence: Meridian's total liability for any claim — including negligence — is capped at the dues and fees you paid in the prior 12 months, and it is not liable at all for lost income, lost business opportunity, or loss of or damage to your property, including property left in a locker; so if the club's conduct causes you a large loss, recovery is limited to roughly a year of what you paid, and stolen or damaged belongings are not recoverable.

flags.sourceSentence: Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition.
flags.consequence: Your Program enrolment renews automatically each year at the then-current tuition — which may be higher than what you paid — unless you give written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary date; missing that window commits you to another year of tuition.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: You are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or account, so if your card or account is used by someone else you could be charged for their access or held responsible for their conduct under the indemnity in Section 7.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
flags.consequence: If the plot holder ends the licence early, the whole $45 fee is kept by the Association with no refund, even for the months of the season they will not use, though they may still harvest what is ready during the notice period.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Any of the plot holder's belongings left on the plot after 15 December 2027 — canes, netting, frames or other items — is lost to the Association, which may keep or dispose of it.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Northwind can raise the subscription fee, and the new amount applies automatically from the start of a Billing Period beginning more than thirty days after an email notice, without the signer's agreement and with no stated cap on the increase. The signer's only way to avoid the higher fee is to cancel before it takes effect.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: On an annual plan, missing the cancellation deadline commits the signer to a further twelve months at whatever the annual fee is at that time, with no fresh signature. On a monthly plan, a cancellation made even one day into a new Billing Period means the fee already collected for that period is not refunded.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: Northwind can change the terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, and the changes take effect simply by being posted to a webpage — the signer accepts them by continuing to use the service, with no notice requirement, no cap on what can change, and no right to leave without consequence beyond cancelling.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay Northwind's legal costs and any third-party claim arising from content they uploaded, exported or published — including copyright, trade mark and privacy claims — with no cap on the amount, so exposure could far exceed what they paid for the service.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to sue in court or join a class action against Northwind; disputes go to individual binding arbitration with a final award, leaving only small claims court for qualifying individual claims. A serious problem affecting many users (for example a widespread loss of stored work) could not be pursued collectively.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: A missed or failed payment triggers interest at 1.5 percent per month (18 percent a year) on the unpaid amount, plus a reactivation charge whose amount is set in a Fee Schedule the signer was not given, so the total cost of a lapse is open-ended and partly unknown.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: If the service fails — including losing the signer's work or a failed export — the most Northwind owes is the amount paid for the single Billing Period in which the claim arose, and the service credit is the exclusive remedy for downtime, so a month of lost work could be worth only one month's fee.

flags.sourceSentence: We may suspend or close an account that has not paid, that has breached Section 1, or that is being used to store content we are required by law to remove.
flags.consequence: If Northwind closes the account for an alleged breach of Section 1 (for example, its belief that credentials were shared), the signer loses access and gets no refund of the Billing Period already paid for; the refund right applies only where Northwind closes the account for a reason other than the listed ones.

flags.sourceSentence: You may not share your credentials with anyone else, and an account we believe is being used by more than one person may be suspended while we ask you about it.
flags.consequence: The account can be suspended while Northwind investigates its own belief that more than one person is using it, interrupting the signer's access to the tool they paid for based on Northwind's suspicion alone.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: The signer must repay the entire $15,000 signing payment within 30 days of their last working day if they resign or are terminated for cause within the first 12 months — even if the resignation is for reasons outside their control and even though the money will largely have been spent by then.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can unilaterally change, withdraw or reinterpret any policy, benefit plan or term of employment described in the letter — including compensation-related terms — without the signer's agreement, with the change taking effect simply by being published on the company intranet. The clause names no cap on changes and no right to leave without penalty.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends — even if Ardent ends it — the signer cannot work in any capacity for any business in the Restricted Field, and cannot solicit Ardent employees or approach Ardent customers, distributors or contract manufacturers they dealt with. The scope of 'Restricted Field' and the geographic limits are in Exhibit B, which the signer has not supplied, so the breadth of the bar is unknown. The signer acknowledges a breach causes harm money cannot repair, which supports injunctive enforcement.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must personally pay Ardent's claims, losses, liabilities and expenses, including attorney fees, arising from an alleged breach of the confidentiality, non-compete or non-solicitation sections — an open-ended amount — and also for claims by a former employer that the new job breaches an obligation owed to them, even if the signer did not realise such an obligation existed.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and to join a class, collective or representative action for any employment-related claim, including statutory claims; claims must go to individual binding arbitration. The signer also cannot pursue a claim together with other similarly affected employees, which often matters most for pay or discrimination patterns. Either side can still seek a temporary restraining order or preliminary injunction in court.

flags.sourceSentence: On or before your start date you will sign the Employee Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement enclosed with this letter. It survives the end of your employment.
flags.consequence: The signer must sign the enclosed Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement before starting, and its obligations continue after employment ends. The text of that agreement is not in the document supplied, so its invention-assignment scope and any post-employment restrictions are unknown.

flags.sourceSentence: You confirm that you are not subject to any obligation to a former employer that would prevent you from performing this role, and that you will not bring to Ardent or use in your work any confidential information belonging to anyone else.
flags.consequence: The signer personally warrants they are free of any conflicting obligation to a former employer; if that turns out to be wrong, the indemnity in Section 6 makes them liable for Ardent's resulting claims and expenses.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: The occupant must keep insurance on the stored property for its full value and produce evidence on request; without it, the occupant bears all risk of loss, and even with it, the operator's liability for loss or damage — including damage caused by the operator's own negligence — is capped at $5,000 unless a higher value was declared and a fee paid up front.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must pay for and defend against every claim, demand, loss, cost, and expense — including attorney fees — brought by any person arising from the occupant's use of the unit, the stored property, or the acts of anyone the occupant allows on the premises, with no cap stated.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The operator can change the rent, the rules, gate hours, and any other term of the agreement on its own, with the changed version binding the occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted at the facility and emailed; the clause names no cap on increases and no right to leave without penalty.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: Unpaid rent or charges give the operator a lien on everything stored in the unit, allowing it to deny the occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the required notice period sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: Late rent triggers a late charge and per-notice administration charges whose amounts are not stated in the agreement itself; they are set in a Schedule of Charges posted in the office and on the website, so the occupant is agreeing to figures they cannot see in this document, and each additional notice about an unpaid balance adds another charge.

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: The agreement renews itself month to month without any fresh signature or notice from the occupant, so it does not end on its own; the occupant must give written notice at least ten days before the end of a month to stop it, and rent paid for the move-out month is not refunded.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may enter the unit to inspect it, to repair the premises, or where the Operator reasonably believes the contents present a danger, and will leave notice of the entry in or on the unit.
flags.consequence: The operator can enter the unit to inspect it, to repair the premises, or where it reasonably believes the contents present a danger, leaving only a notice in or on the unit afterward rather than giving advance notice.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent already paid for the month in which the Occupant moves out is not refunded.
flags.consequence: Rent already paid for the month in which the occupant moves out is not refunded, so the occupant pays for days they will not use if they leave mid-month.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: A twelve-month promotional plan automatically renews for another twelve-month term at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate unless the signer tells Cascade to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term — missing that deadline commits the signer to a further fixed term at a higher, unstated rate.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term of the agreement, any charge, and any feature of the rate plan on notice delivered by bill, device message or email, and the signer accepts the change just by continuing to use the service. The only stated limit is a 30-day cancellation window without an early termination charge when a change materially increases the monthly recurring charge — no cap on the size of any increase, and no exit right for other kinds of changes.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover any claim, loss or expense — including reasonable legal fees — arising from use of the service, anything sent from or stored on the device, use of the line by anyone the signer allows, and any charge incurred on the account. This is open-ended and extends to charges incurred on the account regardless of fault.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, and must resolve any dispute in individual binding arbitration — removing court and group-action routes for contesting serious problems. The signer can reject this by writing to Cascade within 30 days of activating service without affecting service or rate.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: An unpaid balance accrues a late charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance each bill period until paid, so the charge compounds on the growing balance, and restoring a suspended line adds a restoral charge set in the Rate and Charge Guide, which was not provided.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: If the signer cancels a promotional plan before the end of its term, the entire unpaid device instalment balance becomes due in full on the next bill, regardless of how much of the instalment plan remains.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim — contract, negligence, warranty or statute — is capped at the service charges for the affected line for the single bill period in which the claim arose, and lost profits, lost data and indirect or consequential losses are excluded entirely.

flags.sourceSentence: Data speeds on an unlimited plan may be reduced after you use the monthly priority allowance shown on your Service Summary, and reduced speeds continue until the next bill period starts.
flags.consequence: On an unlimited plan, data speeds are reduced after the signer uses the monthly priority allowance shown on the Service Summary, and reduced speeds continue until the next bill period starts.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: Charges continue to the end of the bill period in which the signer cancels, and the part bill period is not prorated, so the signer pays for days of service they will not use after cancelling.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week Programme at any point for any reason, cutting off the remaining stipend weeks with only one week's pay of notice.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can rewrite the Handbook, the assessments, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement itself, by email, with the changes taking effect the moment the email is sent — including terms that could reduce the stipend or add obligations, with no cap and no right for the Analyst to leave without penalty.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the Programme ends, the Analyst cannot take any engagement, paid or unpaid, with any firm on a list they may not fully know in advance (it is confidential and can be reissued), and cannot approach clients they worked on — restricting their job search after the stipend has stopped.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must pay the Firm's claims, losses, expenses and legal costs arising from a confidentiality or non-compete breach, or from anything they publish about the Firm or its clients — an open-ended amount with no cap.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action, and must pursue any dispute — including over the indemnity or post-programme restrictions — alone in individual, final and binding arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: A late charge of an unspecified size, set in the Programme Handbook, is added to the housing advance repayment and keeps growing until the advance is repaid in full.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: The Analyst is charged the replacement cost of any issued item — laptop, security token or building pass — if it is not returned within five working days, with the amount set in a Handbook they have not yet seen.

flags.sourceSentence: Two or more missed lessons in a row may be carried into the following session at no charge, on the Centre's agreement.
flags.consequence: Carrying two or more consecutive missed lessons into the next session happens only if the Centre agrees, so the signer has no assured make-up for those lessons and could lose the lesson time already paid for.

flags.sourceSentence: After the third lesson no refund is made.
flags.consequence: If the place is given up after the third lesson, none of the $120 fee is returned, even for the remaining lessons the child will not attend; between the first and third lessons only half the fee ($60) is returned.
